name: Plants vs. Zombies 2: It's Fighting Time!
desc: Buried Seedling: It's Fighting Time! otherwise known as PvZ: It's Fighting Time! is a competitive fighting game in the Buried Seedling series. Play as either Plants or Zombies and battle over control of the lawn. It is inspired off the Plants vs. Zombies / PvZ Franchise created by tunnnn and reuploaded as a new version, all credits go to PopCap and EA. To gain wins, you must win as the team you are playing on. Tags: PVZ, Plants vs. Zombies, Plants vs. Zombies 2, PVZ2, PVZIFT, IFT, PvZ, Plants vs. Zombies 2 It's About Time
